_doc: Single-source config for leoslectures.com. Change these values here; the build picks them up. Leave a value empty ('') to disable that feature.

hub.name: Leo's Lectures
hub.tagline: Courses I build while learning the subject myself.
hub.description: Original, free courses — made as I learn each subject. Italian ⇄ English today; QA and GMP tomorrow.
hub.author: Leo Chimienti

analytics._doc: Cookieless, privacy-friendly only. Default off. Fill 'script' and 'domain' to enable Plausible / Umami. Example Plausible: {"script": "https://plausible.io/js/script.js", "domain": "leoslectures.com"}

description.en: A two-way Italian ⇄ English course for 2026. Luca or Lucia moves from Toronto to a town in Puglia; their cousin Chiara moves to Toronto. Same cast, two directions, A1 to B1.
description.it: Un corso italiano ⇄ inglese a due direzioni per il 2026. Luca o Lucia si trasferisce da Toronto a un paese in Puglia; la cugina Chiara si trasferisce a Toronto. Stesso cast, due direzioni, dall'A1 al B1.

description.en: Quality Assurance and Good Manufacturing Practice, written as I learn them. Not available yet.
description.it: Quality Assurance e GMP, scritte man mano che le imparo. Non ancora disponibile.

deploy._doc: Target host for leoslectures.com. See DEPLOY.md.
